name: @activepieces/piece-apify
description: Access Apify tools for web scraping, data extraction, and automation.

apikey.description: Find your API key on Apify in the settings, API & Integrations section.

datasetId.description: Select the dataset to get items from.

offset.description: Number of items that should be skipped at the start. The default value is `0`.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Must be greater than 0.

aiMetadata.description: Reads the stored result rows from an Apify dataset by dataset ID, with optional offset/limit paging. Use this to fetch the scraped/extracted output of an actor or task run once you know its dataset ID. Read-only and idempotent; it returns existing items without modifying them.

runActor.name: runActor
runActor.description: Runs an Actor and returns all associated details.

actorid.description: Select an Actor from the list.

build.description: Build to run. It can be either a build tag or build number. By default, the run uses the build specified in the default run configuration (typically `latest`).

memory.description: Memory limit for the run, in megabytes. The amount of memory can be set to one of the available options. By default, the run uses a memory limit specified in the default run configuration for the Actor.

timeout.description: Optional timeout for the run, in seconds. By default, the run uses a timeout specified in the default run configuration for the Actor.

waitForFinish.description: If enabled, the step waits for the Actor run to finish and returns the run’s dataset items as the step output.

aiMetadata.description: Starts an Apify Actor (a hosted scraper/automation program) by actor ID, passing a JSON input body and optional build/memory/timeout settings. Use this to execute a specific Actor for scraping or data extraction; set waitForFinish to block until the run completes and fetch its dataset items. Not idempotent — each call launches a new actor run.

runTask.name: runTask
runTask.description: Runs an Actor task and returns all associated details.

taskid.description: Select a task from the list.

build.description: Build to run. It can be either a build tag or build number. By default, the run uses the build specified in the default run configuration (typically `latest`).

memory.description: Memory limit for the run, in megabytes. The amount of memory can be set to one of the available options. By default, the run uses a memory limit specified in the task settings.

timeout.description: Optional timeout for the run, in seconds. By default, the run uses a timeout specified in the task settings.

waitForFinish.description: If enabled, the step waits for the task run to finish and returns the run’s dataset items as the step output.

aiMetadata.description: Runs a saved Apify Actor task (an Actor pre-configured with stored input) by task ID, optionally overriding the input body and build/memory/timeout. Use this instead of Run Actor when the user has an existing configured task to execute; set waitForFinish to block until completion and retrieve dataset items. Not idempotent — each call launches a new task run.

getKeyValueStoreRecord.name: getKeyValueStoreRecord
getKeyValueStoreRecord.description: Retrieves a value stored in the key-value store under a specific key

store.description: The ID of the Key-Value Store.

recordKey.description: The key of the record to be retrieved.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a single record from an Apify key-value store by store ID and record key, returning JSON/text values inline or binary values as a file reference. Use this to read named outputs an actor saved (e.g. screenshots, structured results, or status keys) rather than dataset rows. Read-only and idempotent; errors if the key does not exist.

scrapeSingleUrl.name: scrapeSingleUrl
scrapeSingleUrl.description: Scrape a single URL using the Apify Website Content Crawler Actor and get its content as markdown and HTML.

url.description: URL to be scraped. Must start with http:// or https:// and be a valid URL.

crawlerType.description: The type of crawler to use.

aiMetadata.description: Scrapes the content of one web page via the Apify Website Content Crawler Actor and returns its text as markdown and HTML. Use this for a quick single-page extraction without configuring a full Actor run; the URL must be a valid http/https address and crawler type (Cheerio or Playwright) selects the rendering engine. Not idempotent — each call launches a new crawler run.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

apikey.description: Find your API key on Apify in the settings, API & Integrations section.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

apikey.description: Find your API key on Apify in the settings, API & Integrations section.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

watchActorRunsTrigger.name: watchActorRunsTrigger
watchActorRunsTrigger.description: Triggers a Flow on Apify Actor run events

actorid.description: Select an Actor from the list.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a run of the selected Apify Actor reaches one of the chosen statuses (e.g. succeeded, failed, aborted). Use to react to an Actor finishing, delivering the run event payload via webhook.

watchTaskRunsTrigger.name: watchTaskRunsTrigger
watchTaskRunsTrigger.description: Triggers a Flow on Apify Actor task run events

taskid.description: Select a task from the list.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a run of the selected Apify Actor task reaches one of the chosen statuses (e.g. succeeded, failed, aborted). Use to react to a configured task finishing, delivering the run event payload via webhook.

pt.Number of items that should be skipped a: Número de itens que devem ser ignorados no início. O valor padrão é '0'.
pt.Maximum number of results to return. Mus: Número máximo de resultados para retornar. Deve ser maior que 0.
pt.Build to run. It can be either a build t: Compilação para executar. Pode ser uma etiqueta de compilação ou um número de compilação. Por padrão, a execução usa a compilação especificada na configuração padrão de execução (normalmente `latest`).
Limite de memória para execução, em megabytes. A quantidade de memória pode ser definida para uma das opções disponíveis. Por padrão, a execução usa um limite de memória especificado na configuração padrão de execução do Ator.
pt.Optional timeout for the run, in seconds: Tempo limite opcional para a execução, em segundos. Por padrão, a execução usa um tempo limite especificado na configuração padrão de execução do Ator.
pt.If enabled, the step waits for the Actor: Se ativado, o passo aguarda que o Ator execute termine e retorne os itens do conjunto de dados da execução como a saída de etapa.
Limite de memória para execução, em megabytes. A quantidade de memória pode ser definida para uma das opções disponíveis. Por padrão, a execução usa um limite de memória especificado nas configurações da tarefa.
pt.Optional timeout for the run, in seconds: Tempo limite opcional para a execução, em segundos. Por padrão, a execução usa um tempo limite especificado nas configurações da tarefa.
pt.If enabled, the step waits for the task: Se ativado, o passo aguarda o término da tarefa e retorna os itens do conjunto de dados da execução como a saída da etapa.
